name: Howe Yuan
description_html:
THE HUMAN COIN TOSS On his day, he’s fucking Neuer. Pulls off saves that make you question the laws of physics, screams at defenders like he’s captaining Real Madrid, and somehow turns into a brick wall whenever the opposition gets within 20 yards. 10/10. Unplayable. Absolute monster.

Unfortunately, his “day” occurs approximately once every three months. The other 89 days, he’s a fucking liability. Near post? Free. Cross coming in? Hope for the best. Ball rolling slowly towards him? Genuinely 50/50. You never know which goalkeeper is turning up. Could be prime Buffon. Could be a bloke who has just discovered what gloves are. Rating: 10/10 if switched on. Rating: 1/10 if he woke up on the wrong side of the bed. Overall: 5/10 — statistically impossible to trust.
